Description.SourceString:
You’ll be pleased to learn, dear adventurer, that the first person to make this crossbow in Ashenfall is, indeed, you… or your friend if there are a few of you around.

The techniques that create them are no different to the previous crossbows, but the wood is sturdier, stronger and capable of sufficiently more damage when wielded with skill.

The Moon Garou are traditionalists, preferring the art of archery in hunting and combat, so why not take this opportunity to show them how much they’re missing out.
